guides.edit:
# Editing Pro

Pro is built on two blues: navy (`brand-ink`, `surface-dark`) for weight, cyan (`accent`) for fills and rules. Keep the pairs that read:

- ink and brand-ink on bg and surface; `accent-text` for colored text on light fills; `on-accent` (dark navy) on accent; white, on-dark-body, on-dark-muted and accent-on-dark on surface-dark. Never set a text color to accent on a light fill.
- The extra colors (brand-ink, surface-dark, accent-text, accent-on-dark, on-dark-body, on-dark-muted, white) are named by component tokens, the chart palette, kicker, list and app: rename one and every reference breaks.
- Inter for display and body; weights display and title 800, strong and label 700.
- Sizes (display 104, title 56, body 21), leading, space, page margins (128 sides, 112 top, 160 bottom), radius and stroke are tuned together: change them as a set, then check the band cover, a chapter, a content slide with cards and a table, and the footer.
- component.essentiel: title (brand-ink, tracking -1, accent rule 64 by 5), title-slide (band layout, band-ratio 0.62, surface-dark band, white title, "Confidential" badge), chapter and end-slide (surface-dark, white), toc (accent-text numbers), quote (brand-ink, accent bar), columns (gap 24).
- component.base: card (white, hairline rule border, accent top rule, padding 32 by 36, brand-ink title, highlight on surface-dark) and table (brand-ink header, white text, #f3f5f7 stripes).
- Frame: footer `{n} · {title}` left and `{confidential}` right, header empty, kicker uppercase, list marker • in accent-text.
- `app` and `app-dark` give the app a navy tint; keep app-dark's ink readable on its desk, sheet and piece.
guides.use:
# Using Pro

Pro is a corporate theme: Inter throughout, heavy titles (weight 800), a white `bg`, a light grey `surface`, navy `brand-ink` and `surface-dark` (#00154e), and a bright cyan `accent` (#00bef4) with dark `on-accent` text. Margins are wide (128 pt) and the scale small (titles 56, body 21), for denser business content.

- Accent is for fills: bars, rules, badges, chart series. For colored text on light backgrounds use `accent-text` (#0072b0), never accent, which does not read on white. On surface-dark, write in `white`, `on-dark-body` or `on-dark-muted`, and emphasize with `accent-on-dark`.
- Slide titles are navy with a short cyan rule above; kickers are uppercase in accent-text; bullets are • in accent-text.
- The cover uses the band layout: organization at top left, a "Confidential" badge, the title on a navy band. Chapter and end slides are navy with white text and a cyan chapter number.
- The footer shows the slide number and deck title on the left and, on the right, the deck variable `confidential` when it is set; the header is empty.
- Cards are white with a hairline border and a cyan top rule; a highlighted card turns navy. Tables have navy headers with white text and light grey stripes.
- Charts take accent-text, accent, brand-ink, on-dark-body, on-dark-muted and ink-muted.
- The badge text is the `title-slide.badge` token under component.essentiel: a deck token can change it, or null hides it.
- Prefer cards, tables and charts to long bullet lists, and keep one message per slide.
